name: dont-nod-union-job-cuts
note: تقرير attributed to the STJV union statement (stjv.fr, 27 Oct 2026, carried by Rock Paper Shotgun 12:21Z): under DON'T NOD's safeguard plan nearly all non-managerial jobs are cut (programmers 18 of 22, animators 6 of 6, associate producers 6 of 6); the target organisation is 'inadapted to finishing the last project in-development, P14'; CSE opinion due 3 Nov. No DON'T NOD statement today. Footage: Aphelion launch trailer (Steam 1966410) and Lost Records launch trailer 68 to 72.5 s (no subtitles). Our bed: both trailers are narrated (Aphelion speech 8 to 43 s) and the Reel crosses two trailers.
lines:
حسب نقابة STJV
لعمال الألعاب في فرنسا

تشمل 18 مبرمجًا من 22
وكل فريق التحريك

وترى أن الهيكل الجديد
لا يناسب مشروعها الأخير

ولم تعلّق Don't Nod
على البيان
headline:
